person.headline: Intelligent Semiconductor Engineering · Chung-Ang University
intro: I am with the Department of Intelligent Semiconductor Engineering at Chung-Ang University, where I have been an undergraduate research intern since July 2026.

My work so far spans computer vision and applied machine learning — generative data augmentation for small-sample industrial defect detection, multimodal sensor learning, and 3D reconstruction pipelines.

publications.title: Why Deep ResNets Train Successfully: Self-Selection of Effective Depth Enabled by Skip Connections
publications.summary: Proposes Learnable Residual Scaling (LRS), a learnable scalar α per residual block, showing that deep ResNets self-select an effective depth far smaller than their nominal depth (5–6 active blocks out of 200). On ResNet-200 / CIFAR-100, removing blocks with α < 0.03 causes zero accuracy loss without retraining.

publications.title: Effects of Generative-AI Augmentation for Small-Sample Industrial Defect Detection
publications.summary: Under extreme data scarcity (~20 images per class), semantic diversity matters more than quantity: traditional augmentation gives −1.76 mAP, Gemini-2.0-based generative augmentation +1.90, and their combination at an 8× optimum +5.0 mAP across detector families.

publications.title: An Integrated Preprocessing Pipeline for Model Performance Comparison on a Multimodal Gas Sensor Dataset
publications.summary: Designs a standardized four-stage preprocessing pipeline for the MultimodalGasData benchmark and compares eight models fairly, finding a 22.2%p gap between best and worst and showing that the fusion strategy matters more than model depth.

projects.title: CarNeRF — AI-Powered Used-Car Dealer Platform
projects.subtitle: Team project · Competition
projects.summary: An automated pipeline that turns a seller's one-minute video into FastGS-based 3D reconstruction → YOLOv8 defect detection → LightGBM price prediction → LLM natural-language search. PSNR 31.88 with vanilla 3DGS; about 15× faster after porting to FastGS.

projects.title: ETF with AI — LambdaRank-Based Trading System
projects.subtitle: Team project · Ongoing competition
projects.summary: LightGBM LambdaRank trained on 85 features, integrated with an automated TradingView collector and a Next.js dashboard. Live trading through the Korea Investment & Securities API with cron-based daily prediction and monthly retraining; scaling to 1,000 tickers.

projects.title: JUMP AI 2025 — 3rd Drug Discovery Challenge
projects.subtitle: DACON · Solo · Top 4% (20th / 1,134 teams)
projects.summary: Predicts MAP3K5 IC50 activity from SMILES. Designed 140-dimensional features, tuned five base learners with Optuna, and combined them in a two-track ensemble (SLSQP weighting + quantile matching).

projects.title: Personal Color Diagnosis System
projects.subtitle: Team project · Invited talk, Hwaseong AI Forum
projects.summary: An interactive kiosk web service that diagnoses personal color from a face photo and plays tailored video content. Collected ~50K celebrity reference images; white-balancing with OpenCV skin-tone segmentation; OpenAI prompt routing.
